invariants.rationale: The method returns a Map created by Collectors.toMap, which never returns null.
A null 'data' would cause a NullPointerException before return; the method could not return normally if 'data' was null.
A null 'func' would throw a NullPointerException in throwingMapToPairWrapper(func); normal return implies non-null.
Collectors.toMap uses Pair::getLeft as keys; duplicate keys overwrite, so result.size() is at most data.size().
